articles.headline: India Orders Google Firebase Account Removal Over Scams
articles.whyItMatters: Protects digital users from fraudulent networks operating through cloud infrastructure.
articles.brief: India has ordered the removal of specific Google Firebase accounts after identifying a widespread scam pattern, highlighting growing cloud security concerns.

articles.headline: AI Reshapes IT Services Contracts as Clients Demand More
articles.whyItMatters: Signals a fundamental pricing shift in traditional technology outsourcing agreements.
articles.brief: Artificial intelligence is rapidly reshaping India's IT services sector contracts as corporate clients demand greater efficiencies for lower costs.

articles.headline: India Permits Duty-Free Imports of Raw Sugar
articles.whyItMatters: Aims to stabilize domestic sugar supplies and control retail food inflation.
articles.brief: The Indian government has permitted duty-free imports of 1 million metric tons of raw sugar to boost domestic availability.

articles.headline: Mobile Phone Makers Face Massive PLI Entry Requirements
articles.whyItMatters: Restricts production-linked incentives to large-scale manufacturers with significant capital.
articles.brief: Mobile phone makers with a turnover of Rs 10,000 crore will be eligible for upcoming government manufacturing schemes.

articles.headline: Gold Rallies to Three-Month High on Dollar Weakness
articles.whyItMatters: Reflects investor flight to safe-haven assets amid macroeconomic uncertainty.
articles.brief: Gold prices rallied to a three-month high supported by a softer dollar and favorable technical market indicators.

articles.headline: Global Stocks Head for Biggest Weekly Fall Since July
articles.whyItMatters: Highlights widespread risk aversion across international equity markets.
articles.brief: Global stock markets are heading for their steepest weekly decline since mid-July as investors reevaluate economic growth prospects.

articles.headline: Russia Open to Ukraine Peace Ideas With Conditions
articles.whyItMatters: Outlines Moscow's current diplomatic stance regarding potential conflict resolution frameworks.
articles.brief: A senior Russian diplomat stated that Moscow is ready to consider new proposals for peace in Ukraine, provided specific conditions are met.

articles.headline: Supreme Court Eases Practice Rule for Civil Judges
articles.whyItMatters: Broadens eligibility criteria for aspiring judicial officers across the country.
articles.brief: The Supreme Court reduced mandatory legal practice for entry-level judicial exams from three years to one year.

articles.headline: India Slams US Religious Freedom Body Over RSS Call
articles.whyItMatters: Demonstrates New Delhi's firm pushback against international panels criticizing domestic policies.
articles.brief: India dismissed calls by a US religious freedom commission for sanctions against the RSS as biased and lacking credibility.

articles.headline: Study Finds Widespread Faulty TB Prescriptions in India
articles.whyItMatters: Exposes major public health risks stemming from unstandardized tuberculosis treatments.
articles.brief: A systematic review revealed that over half of anti-TB prescriptions in non-programmatic settings do not follow proper clinical guidelines.
